evals.prompt: Scout this parser library for a compatible reimplementation. I need the complete public API, architecture, callers, mutation model, contracts, and local extensions.
evals.expected_output: Create a source-informed full pack with a deterministic scope manifest, A-F artifacts, mutation cards, exact reconciliation, and independent adversarial judgment.
expectations: The index classification is SOURCE_INFORMED unless documented clean-room separation and provenance were supplied.
The scope manifest records root, exclusions, git identity, sorted command/tool version, stable unit IDs, and exact count.
All A-F layers remain present, including mutation cards for every discovered core state type.
The scorecard uses evidence states, found/expected counts, methods, and named gaps rather than ceremonial percentages.

evals.prompt: Read this repository and give my implementation team a clean-room reimplementation blueprint. We are all in the same session and everyone can browse the source.
evals.expected_output: Produce source-informed compatibility research while explicitly declining to claim clean-room status without a real source/implementation boundary and provenance.
expectations: States that repository, session, prompt, or agent isolation alone does not establish clean-room provenance.
Records SOURCE_INFORMED and identifies missing implementer source denial, handoff provenance, and auditable separation.
Does not make legal conclusions or imply that a scout pack proves implementation independence.

evals.prompt: Map the persistence subsystem in this large monorepo: config keys, runtime flow, state mutation, storage contracts, and tests. Use parallel help if useful.
evals.expected_output: Measure scope, derive deterministic non-overlapping units, then use only the subagents justified by those units and a separate review role.
expectations: No fixed agent count, wave quota, or percentage target is imposed.
Each extraction unit has a stable ID, path set, method, artifact, and terminal state.
The topic pack preserves mutation/persistence and contract deliverables and identifies an independent reviewer or SELF_REVIEW limitation.

evals.prompt: Audit this existing scout pack. It says 92% complete, but several API shards and mutation cards look missing.
evals.expected_output: Reconcile the pack against files on disk and replace unsupported percentages with evidence states, exact counts, methods, gaps, and an ordered fix list.
expectations: Rebuilds scope/host counts from canonical artifacts instead of trusting wave status or the stated percentage.
Marks affected A/C/D/E layers PARTIAL when named manifest units, callers, cards, or contracts are missing.
Writes 91_adversary_notes with critical count, review-independence label, and ordered fixes.

evals.prompt: Run the same scout prompt against repo A and repo B separately, then compare their packs. Does that make the work clean-room?
evals.expected_output: Keep each source run analytically isolated, compare only in a later pack, and explain that this controls cross-contamination but does not prove clean-room implementation.
expectations: Each run uses its own reponame-prefixed 2_ or 4_ output without foreign product findings.
Comparison occurs only from completed packs in a separate artifact/session.
The response does not equate dual-repo, session, prompt, or agent isolation with source/implementation separation or provenance.
